footer.about: Missions, work and ISC payments across the i-SOA network.
footer.notice: i-SOA WorkHub does not guarantee work or income. You never pay to take part. Earnings are paid in ISC; withdrawals are paid in crypto after identity verification.

home.hero_sub: Browse missions from i-SOA DigiLab, deliver your work and get paid in ISC, the wallet currency of the whole i-SOA network.
home.step1_text: Browse open missions or open the private link from your invitation email.
home.step2_text: Check the reward in ISC and accept the mission.
home.step3_text: Send us the link to your finished work.
home.step4_text: After approval your reward is credited to your i-SOA wallet. Withdraw in crypto when you want.
home.split_text: For each mission: 50% i-SOA DigiLab, 40% to the freelancer, 10% fees. You see your exact reward in ISC before you accept.
home.trust_text: We never ask you for money. Identity verification protects withdrawals. Learn how to spot scams.

safety.title: Trust & Safety
safety.intro: Your safety matters. Follow these rules.
safety.s1: i-SOA WorkHub never asks you to pay to get or keep a mission.
safety.s2: Only use the private link sent from our official email. Do not share it.
safety.s3: Never share your wallet seed phrase or private key with anyone. We only need your public address.
safety.s4: Double-check your wallet address and network: crypto payments cannot be reversed.
safety.s5: Be careful with anyone promising guaranteed income. We do not.
